name: dma_wr
contract: linear block write, any byte alignment (V1.2 head offset): awaddr = addr&~7, assembler starts at lane head, first-word wstrb masks head lanes; bursts min(ceil((head+len)/8),16,4KB-boundary); little-endian assembly (source byte k -> lane head+k); one outstanding AW; one B per burst; done after B-count aligns
gold_ref: DDR-side: every strobed byte at address a == F(word(a))>>8*(a%8); per-command count + additive checksum mod 2^64 + written-once bijection walk (command-relative bitmap, overlap-safe)
